blocks.text: Jab darja hararat aur dabao ke bairooni halaat badalte hain to gas ki di gai miqdar ka hajm mutasir hota hai; gas laws gas ki di gai miqdar ke hajm aur maujooda darja hararat aur dabao ke taalluqat bayan karte hain. Boyle aur Charles ke qawaneen mein kuch variables mustaqil rakhe jate hain: Boyle's law se V 1/P ke mutanasib hai jab n aur T mustaqil hon (1); Charles's law se V T ke mutanasib hai jab n aur P mustaqil hon (2); aur Avogadro's law se mustaqil darja hararat aur dabao par gas ka hajm moles ki tadaad ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai, V n ke mutanasib jab P aur T mustaqil hon (3). Agar koi variable mustaqil na rakha jaye to teenon taalluqat mil kar V nT/P ke mutanasib, ya V = constant x nT/P dete hain. Constant R hai, ideal gas constant, jis ki qeemat 0.0821 atm dm3 fi K fi mol hai. Is liye V = RnT/P, yani PV = nRT (4), ideal gas equation.
Gas ke relative molecular mass ka hisab

Muadla (4) us gas ka relative molecular mass deta hai jis ke P, T, V aur grams mein mass maloom hon. n = m/M rakh kar, jahan m grams mein mass aur M molar mass hai, PV = mRT/M (5), aur tarteeb badal kar M = mRT/PV (6). Molecular satah par molar mass relative molecular mass hai, to Mr = mRT/PV (7).

blocks.caption: Sample Problem 5.1
rows: 134 g gas, -73 degrees C (200 K), 10 atm, 5 dm3

blocks.prompt: 21 g gas ka hajm -90 degrees C par 7 atm ke tehat 8 dm3 hai. Us ka relative molecular mass nikalein.
blocks.explanation: T = 273 - 90 = 183 K. M = mRT / PV = (21 x 0.0821 x 183) / (7 x 8) = 315.5 / 56 = 5.6 g/mol, to relative molecular mass taqreeban 5.6 hai (chhape hue data ki gol kari ko dekhte hue helium ke 4 ke qareeb).

items: Boyle (V 1/P ke mutanasib), Charles (V T ke mutanasib) aur Avogadro (V n ke mutanasib) mil kar PV = nRT dete hain, R = 0.0821 atm dm3 fi K fi mol.
n = m/M ke saath relative molecular mass Mr = mRT / PV hai (Sample 5.1: 44).
